# 1.78 release notes [🔗](https://docs.matillion.com/metl/docs/metl-178-release-notes/\#178-release-notes)

Long-term support (LTS)

Welcome to the release notes for Matillion ETL version 1.78. This version is a long-term support (LTS) release, which will be supported until at least November 2026.

Read more about Matillion ETL [supported releases](https://docs.matillion.com/metl/docs/matillion-etl-supported-releases).

Note

If you are upgrading from a version **below 1.78.0** to a version **between 1.78.0 and 1.78.9**, you will need to adjust the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) memory allocation for the Tomcat service immediately after completing the upgrade. For detailed instructions, read the tech note [Adjusting Tomcat memory for Matillion ETL upgrades](https://docs.matillion.com/metl/docs/tech-note-adjusting-tomcat-memory/).

This does not apply if you are upgrading to version **1.78.10 or higher**, as this change will be made automatically as part of the upgrade process to those versions.

- Fixed an issue where S3 URL validation failed in environments that restrict outbound traffic to specific AWS regions, even though reads and writes to the bucket worked. You can now set the new `S3_VALIDATION_PRIORITY_REGIONS` Emerald property to the region or regions your buckets use, and validation tries those regions first. The property is unset by default, so nothing changes unless you configure it.
- Users in the Reader and Reader with Comments groups can now open **Manage Environment Variables**, **Manage Job Variables**, and **Manage Grid Variables**. These menu items were previously greyed out. The dialogs now open in read-only view, and Writer access is unchanged.
- Added support for intermediate certificate chains when configuring SSL certificates in the Admin UI. The SSL dialog now includes an optional **.crt Chain** upload alongside the certificate and key, which prevents `NET::ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID` browser errors for certificates that require an intermediate chain.

### Breaking changes [🔗](https://docs.matillion.com/metl/docs/metl-178-release-notes/\#breaking-changes_35)

The upgrade of the Microsoft JDBC Driver for SQL Server from version `8.2.0.jre8` to `12.8.1.jre11` introduces a potential breaking change for customers connecting to SQL Server instances using self-signed or untrusted certificates.

Beginning with JDBC driver version `10.2`, the default behavior of the `encrypt` setting changed as follows:

- `encrypt=true` is now the default (was previously `false`).
- `trustServerCertificate` is no longer automatically set when `encrypt` is enabled.
- If `trustServerCertificate=true` isn't explicitly added, connection attempts using self-signed or untrusted certificates will fail.

Because of this change, after upgrading from a Matillion ETL version prior to 1.78 you may experience unexpected connection failures if using a SQL Server instance with a self-signed or untrusted certificate. To avoid this, include the following in your JDBC connection strings:

```
trustServerCertificate=true
```

For background information on this upgrade, read [this Microsoft blog post](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/sqlserver/jdbc-driver-10-2-for-sql-server-released/3100754).
